prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct ONLY text optical weight and supporting icon color in image1 for Lighthouse LH09-0042. Original image2 controls fine silhouettes, enclosure and thin optical strokes.
All row text must be Meiryo REGULAR400, no medium/semibold/bold. Body14/24, status metadata12/16, zero tracking. Keep Japanese text exactly unchanged:「担当者を招待する」「未着手」「山田 花子」「2026年4月15日」「準備期間 3」「礼拝の準備」. Keep original thin underlines on task/sprint/project. Reduce the current overly heavy text strokes gently without shrinking font or altering any wording.
Recolor BOTH supporting relation glyphs, the tiny walking person AND the circled right arrow, to exact slate #526173. Circled arrow is currently blue; remove ALL blue from it. Preserve original arrow-in-circle enclosure and walking person's exact posture, fine thin strokes and proportions. Keep neutral gray status dot, white status pill, photo avatar and white cells unchanged.
No other changes: six columns, all dividers, compact row, no new icons, no extra text, no mint/gray panels, no changed date or assignment.
reviewNotes: 通常ウェイトに改善し丸矢印をスレートに訂正。日本語と全6セルを再確認。歩行人物だけ原本由来の薄い灰色が残り、指定スレートへ局所訂正予定。2版を保持。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
